Volume surged 2.18x the 5-day average, but without directional indicator improvement, entry is premature.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100/200($1.16/$1.27): strong long-term trend

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (65.4→66.5) + neutral range continuation + weakening upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0188→-0.0041) + worsening diagnosis + bearish reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $1.31) + excessive band width 54.46%

· Swing Resistance ($1.47) + potential challenge of upper band ($1.67) upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (consolidation) + lack of directional trend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (2.18x 5-day average) + increased confidence in movement
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + buy entry after RSI recovers above 50 and MACD improvement confirmed
